description: The attachment references an import reads in one block's text: `detect_attachment_refs` in `src-tauri/agaric-engine/src/import.rs` and its pre-scan `scanAttachmentRefs` in `src/lib/import-attachments.ts`, each listing the distinct refs in the order it finds them. `tsRefs` is the TypeScript side's answer where it differs, and such a row says why in `note`.

cases.name: an Obsidian embed
an Obsidian embed's |display suffix is dropped
an Obsidian embed's name may hold a space
a markdown image
a Logseq asset path
embeds come before images, each in source order
a ref named twice is one ref
a ref in inline code is skipped
URLs, data: URIs and attachment: refs are skipped
an image's title in double quotes is not part of its name
an image's title in single quotes is not part of its name
an image's title in parentheses is not part of its name
a bare markdown image name with a space is not a ref
cases.note: As CommonMark reads it: a bare destination ends at the space, and `image.png` is no title. A name with a space is written `<my image.png>` or `my%20image.png`, as the rows below read.

cases.name: a markdown image name may hold balanced parentheses
an unbalanced ( leaves no image
a percent-encoded name is decoded
percent-encoded UTF-8 is decoded, a BOM kept and an invalid byte read as U+FFFD
a malformed percent escape stays as written
an angle-bracketed destination may hold a space
an angle-bracketed destination loses its brackets
an angle-bracketed destination may carry a title
a link to a file
a link's angle-bracketed destination may hold a space
a link's percent-encoded destination is decoded
a link's title is not part of its name
embeds come first, then images and links in source order
a link in inline code is skipped
a link to a note is not a ref
cases.note: A note imports as a page, and a link to it is a page link (a `.md` one becomes `[[title]]`), never an attachment. These are the extensions a folder import reads as notes.

cases.name: a link to a URL, a fragment or a mail address is not a ref
a link to an attachment: id is not a ref
cases.note: The id names an attachment of the Agaric database that wrote the file, whose bytes an import does not carry. A ZIP export writes each such link as `assets/<name>`, which reads as a link to a file.

cases.name: a link around an image reads the image only
cases.note: A link whose text holds brackets is not read, as `[see [1]](paper.pdf)` is not; the image inside it is.

cases.name: U+FEFF ends a markdown image's name in JS, not in Rust
cases.note: Rust's \s is Unicode White_Space, which U+FEFF is not; JS's \s holds U+FEFF. No vault file is named so.

cases.name: U+0085 around an embed name is trimmed in Rust, not in JS
cases.note: Rust's trim strips Unicode White_Space, which holds U+0085; JS's trim does not strip it. No vault file is named so.
